name: aj-fit-functions
description: AJ Fit backend — Firebase Cloud Functions v2 for billing, promotions, authentication and Photo Vault.

scripts.prebuild: npm run sync:scheduleEngine && npm run sync:prescriptionEngine
scripts.pretypecheck: npm run sync:scheduleEngine && npm run sync:prescriptionEngine
scripts.pretest: npm run sync:scheduleEngine && npm run sync:prescriptionEngine
scripts.deploy:production: npm run build && ../node_modules/.bin/firebase deploy --only functions --project production
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run build && ../node_modules/.bin/firebase deploy --only functions --project staging
